note: Press question catalogue. code = research code (research/press/taxonomy.md) the topic is counted under. level both|pro|college. evergreen 1 = can be asked with no triggering event (subject 'general' or the next opponent). triggers = PressEvent types that create a subject for it. harm = X2.1.2 harm class of the question. n = neutral and soft wordings, p = probing and hostile wordings. Placeholders: {player} {opponent} {staff} {detail} {stat} {team} {record}. Wording is design (Assumption); the topics come from real transcripts.
